policy.scope: Repository-wide. The curated vocabularies below are the kernel and cross-runtime sets; the generated inventory maps every other closed-set carrier under loopx/ so additions are visible in a diff.
policy.closed_sets: Every value a registered vocabulary may carry is listed here. Adding, renaming, or removing a value is a registry edit reviewed with the code change; an unregistered literal fails the drift smoke.
policy.owner_exclusivity: A registered symbol is defined only in its listed owner modules. Any other module imports it instead of redefining the literal. An owner is always module::Symbol or null; a null owner requires a literal_scan.
policy.budgets_only_decrease: Retirement, twin, and inventory-ratchet budgets only fall. Lowering a budget is a routine edit; raising one needs the maintainer approval recorded in the RFC decision log. Each budget must equal its BUDGET_ANCHOR or RETIREMENT_ANCHOR literal in the drift smoke, so tightening edits the JSON and the code literal in one diff, and a later diff cannot raise the JSON back toward a stale anchor.
policy.coverage_only_grows: coverage_floor counts only rise. Removing a vocabulary, owner, projection, relation, or scan suffix must lower the floor in the same diff, which is a schema reduction under AGENTS.md. Each floor must equal its COVERAGE_ANCHOR literal in the drift smoke, so growing coverage edits the JSON and the code literal in one diff, and the floor cannot be lowered in the same diff that removes the coverage it counts.
policy.value_shape: Registered values are lower snake_case tokens (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$). The literal scan captures any quoted string so a malformed or versioned spelling is reported, not skipped.
policy.literal_scan_forms: The dispatch forms the scan recognises are fixed in the smoke, not in this file: comparison or assignment against a literal (== != === !== : = is), a JS/TS ternary, membership in an inline collection, and a Python conditional expression.

universes.values: U(v): ambient runtime values; S(v): registered admitted values
universes.sites: L: source locations that define, produce, consume, interpret, pass through, project, or persist values
universes.roles: Roles assigned to sites; a site may have more than one role only when each edge is explicit

candidate_decisions.meaning: Advisory vocabulary-candidate disposition labels and default; no per-candidate storage or runtime enforcement is implied. Unknown records unresolved bounded evidence, not proof of safety.

relations.defines: D ⊆ L × V: a site defines a vocabulary carrier
relations.produces: P ⊆ L × V × U(v): a site writes or returns a runtime value; it is valid only when the value is in S(v)
relations.consumes: C ⊆ L × V × U(v): a site accepts or branches on a runtime value
relations.interprets: I ⊆ L × V × V: a site maps one vocabulary into another
relations.passes_through: T ⊆ L × V: a site serializes, persists, forwards, or displays without changing meaning
relations.projects: G ⊆ V × V × (S(v_source) ⇀ S(v_target) ∪ {reject}): a declared projection between registered admitted sets
relations.persists: R ⊆ L × V × Version: a site writes a value to a durable representation

invariants.evidence: bounded production-form AST scan; unknown dynamic producers are reported, not treated as proven safe
every kernel value has a recognised producer or an explicit compatibility-only reason

invariants.statement: Accepted(c) ⊆ S(v), unless the consumer declares an external or partial domain
invariants.evidence: consumer and interpreter edges are currently inventory evidence, not complete data-flow proof

invariants.statement: A name collision is a semantic conflict only when its declared scopes overlap
invariants.evidence: scope declarations and per-context owners; scope is never inferred from spelling

invariants.statement: For every source value, a projection maps to a target value or explicit reject
invariants.evidence: registry mapping is compared with the executable owner function

invariants.statement: A persisted vocabulary change preserves readers or declares a versioned migration
invariants.evidence: requires producer, serializer, storage, reader, and migration edges not yet modeled

turn_route_to_loop_disposition.meaning: Total mapping the pure controller applies to a typed route; null means the route is rejected before projection.

should_run_legacy_decision_fields.meaning: Decision fields the should-run documentation already calls legacy. Budgets count modules under loopx/ that still mention the field.

dual_runtime_twins.meaning: Same-basename .py/.ts module pairs under the control plane. The TypeScript migration RFC is replacement-first, so this count may only fall.

inventory_ratchets.meaning: Counts read from the generated inventory. A same-runtime fork is one constant name with one value defined in two or more modules of the same runtime; a conflicting value is one name with different values. Both the number of affected names and the number of definitions are budgets, so a third spelling of an already-conflicting name is still a regression.
inventory_ratchets.multi_value_meaning: Enums, named closed sets, Literal aliases, and TypeScript as-const arrays are vocabulary exactly as a NAME = "value" constant is, so they get the same collision rule. One name defined in two modules with identical values is a twin; with different values it is a fork. The semantic multi-value-fork budget excludes only names declared in scope_declarations.
inventory_ratchets.multi_value_forks_note: The 4 counted forks include SOURCE_SURFACES, whose four definitions are four CLI commands each listing its own data sources; that is bounded-context reuse of one name, not drift. It stays in the budget until M0.5 adds a scope field (RFC Section 5) and must not be removed by renaming.
inventory_ratchets.semantic_meaning: same_runtime_forks_semantic and conflicting_values_semantic exclude module-local convention names such as SCHEMA_VERSION, COMMAND, or *_LABEL, which every module legitimately names for itself. The remaining names are shared vocabulary, where a duplicate is real drift rather than local naming; the unfiltered totals stay visible in the generated inventory summary.
